item.description: - **Smarter layout memory**: a chat keeps the layout most of its recent words were in, so one foreign word does not flip it; a chat written in two languages is left alone. - **The chat helps fix words**: the layout a chat is usually typed in counts as evidence — more wrong-layout words are fixed (87.8 % against 86.8 % on the test set, precision unchanged), and Russian or Ukrainian is chosen by the language of the chat. - **Always one layout in an app**: "Always ABC" (or any enabled layout) in the menu-bar panel and Settings → Apps. - **Safari's address field** starts in Latin and is remembered apart from the tab. - **Statistics** show how often the layout was chosen for you. - **Copy Diagnostics** and **Report a Problem…** in Settings → About — counts and settings only. - **Shortcuts for transliteration, case and the copied text** — off until turned on in Settings → General. - The rules for Telegram, WhatsApp, Signal, Messages and Notes are now a data file.

- **Automatic updates** with Sparkle 2. Backshift asks on its second launch whether it may check for updates; Settings → About has the switch and "Check for Updates…". An update found in the background is offered in the menu-bar panel, not in a window over your work. - The update check is the only network connection Backshift makes; nothing about you or your typing is sent. Organizations can turn it off with the managed key `SUEnableAutomaticChecks`, or deploy the offline build (`OFFLINE=1`), which has no networking code. - Versions before 0.3.0 have no updater: install this one by hand once.
